regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. While I feel it really a privilege to help one another and to save our neighbor a step whoever he be, I want to thank you for your practical assistance to this - I was going to say - poor old sinner. -- rapidly getting old at least. After all, since we have nothing of our own, what we do, in the order especially, we do for the community and in a way it is sure to come back so us again - in many cases it comes back in many ways. As V. Br. Rufin exclaimed when he was treating my other foot a few years ago, and I remarked: "Every time you save your neighbor a step you gain one for yourself" - "You gain at least two steps for yourself .. " So I hope you gain many favors for what you do for Br. Francis and myself and the whole community. Many thanks too for the medicine forwarded and the per- sonal letters, etc. In case any of my friends ask - just cell them I am improving and thankful for such a restful contrast after nearly forty years - over 18 years in Detroit. God willing, I hope to be well be- fore long and possibly back "at the old stand. " .... God bless you again and Br. Francis too and all the brothers and novices and. .. community ... Praised se Jesus!
